svg.title: The Measured Course
svg.desc: A RoboLore instructional diagram showing a 30-centimetre measured course for testing driveDistance(30), including start tape, target tape, a plus or minus two centimetre landing zone, running room, a ruler, and setup steps.

path.aria-label: Set this up before Step 8. The robot must land within ±2 cm of the 30 cm target.

g.aria-label: Zumo robot with front edge on the start tape

path.aria-label: front edge on the 0 cm line
Lay a strip of tape on the floor.
Measure 30 cm along the floor and lay a second strip.
Leave open floor beyond it—about a metre in total.

g.aria-label: Set the robot with its front edge on the 0 cm tape.
